authored.observedEffect: Current-run source policy classified PURE_C. The canonical focused linked diff accepted the 796-byte .ob64.r3750 owner and exact 54-relocation contract. It compared all 199 decoded instruction rows and found six differing linked words (ten bytes), confined to z64 0x00200020, 0x00200024, 0x0020002C, 0x00200030, 0x00200034 and 0x00200038. The candidate loads offset before position, saves offset before the sum, forms the sum in v1, and delays the original-position copy to the bgez slot. Retail requires the opposite two load/register orders and copies before the sum.

The two identical-arm conditions are compiler-shaping devices whose exact current effect needs explanation near any eventual production source.
